Send a photo or note — it is saved on the active project chat.

Buttons:
Projects — pick a project
Status — show the active chat
Deploy — upload pending files
Clear chat — clear app history
Clear Telegram — delete TG messages + clear app

codex.help.title: Codex CLI setup guide
codex.help.subtitle: Install Codex, pick a provider (Ollama local free / OpenRouter / OpenAI), then enable the bridge.

codex.help.s1.title: 1) Install / update Codex CLI
codex.help.s1.body: Install CLI for first setup. Update CLI upgrades to the latest npm package (silent when possible). While GitDeploy is open it also auto-checks about every 24 hours.
codex.help.s2.title: 2) If npm is missing
codex.help.s2.body: Install Node.js LTS from nodejs.org, reopen GitDeploy, then Install CLI again.
codex.help.s3.title: 3) Pick a provider
codex.help.s3.body: For unlimited free coding: install Ollama, pull a coding model, set Provider=Ollama. OpenRouter is cloud free but rate-limited. OpenAI is paid and most reliable. Save writes ~/.codex/config.toml.
codex.help.s4.title: 4) Model
codex.help.s4.body: OpenRouter default: poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free. Ollama: gpt-oss:20b or qwen2.5-coder. LM Studio: the loaded model id. OpenAI: gpt-5-mini / gpt-5.2.
codex.help.s5.title: 5) GitDeploy settings
codex.help.s5.body: Enable Codex bridge, choose Provider, Detect Codex, Save. Click Test connection. In Telegram tap Engine → Codex. GitDeploy must stay open.
codex.help.s6.title: 6) Test
codex.help.s6.body: Use Test connection here or in Settings (checks binary + provider). Then send a real Telegram chat message — not a menu button.

cursor.help.s1.title: 1) Install Cursor CLI
cursor.help.s1.body: In GitDeploy click Install CLI (opens a visible PowerShell window), or run the command below manually. Official docs: cursor.com/docs/cli/overview
cursor.help.s2.title: 2) First login (one time) — important
cursor.help.s2.body: Prefer the Login to Cursor button below (opens PowerShell + browser). Manual equivalent if you need it:
cursor.help.s3.title: 3) If PowerShell blocks scripts
cursor.help.s3.body: Error: running scripts is disabled. Either always use agent.cmd (recommended), or allow scripts for your user:
cursor.help.s4.title: 4) Workspace trust
cursor.help.s4.body: After login you may see Workspace Trust Required. Press a (Trust this workspace) so headless runs from GitDeploy work. GitDeploy already passes --trust --force for project chats.
cursor.help.s5.title: 5) GitDeploy settings
cursor.help.s5.body: Enable Cursor bridge, click Detect agent (should find agent.cmd), Save Cursor. Telegram must be enabled with your user id. GitDeploy must stay open while messages arrive.
cursor.help.s6.title: 6) Test
cursor.help.s6.body: Send a real message (not /start or menu buttons) to the bot for the active project. You should see Cursor agent started… in the chat, then a reply.
